children: on Monday it appointed President International and former CFO Loïc Moreau as interim CFO, succeeding John Landry, effective Oct. 2, 2026.
Moreau brings more than 20 years of finance experience, including senior roles at GSK and earlier positions at EY and PwC.
The company also reaffirmed its 2026 guidance, including worldwide net revenue of €36M-$40M and gross margin of 60%-62%.
The company continues to expect total operating expenses of €99M-$102M and non-GAAP cash operating expenses of €88M-$90M for 2026.
